name: theme
description: The app's theme: (theme, and theme/chrome without Web Awesome's native styles) Web Awesome set up with its --wa-* design tokens retoned for the brand, following the system's light/dark mode, (theme/vscode) mapped onto the active VS Code color theme in the workbench document, and (theme/exceptions/*) the custom CSS that's left, each file a named exception (PLAN.md).
